verdict.rationale: Appwrite Storage documents APIs to upload, download, delete and list files, and serves assets through the Appwrite CDN with bucket-level compression and encryption. Image transformations from the preview endpoint add depth. However, nothing in the pack documents file-level or bucket-level access rules or permissions for storage; the permissions mention refers to databases. missing for 10: documented storage access rules/permissions, independent or hands-on corroboration of CDN delivery.

support.subject: As a developer, I can upload and serve user files with access rules and CDN-backed delivery

citations.quote: It provides APIs to upload, download, delete, and list files, with many added utilities.
Upload, organize, and serve images, videos, documents, and other assets through Appwrite CDN
Use the preview endpoint to resize, crop, convert format, set quality, add borders, and rotate from a single upload.
